newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Blast damages Dutch ENCI plant, output continues.
newsitem.headline: Blast damages Dutch ENCI plant, output continues.

text.p: A gas explosion destroyed part of ENCI Nederland NV's cement production plant at Maastricht on Saturday morning, a company spokesman said on Sunday.
ENCI Nederland is owned 80.9 percent by Belgian cement company CBR SA and the balance by CBR's German parent company Heidelberger Zement.
Plant manager Theo Pluijmen said nobody was hurt in the 0130 GMT blast at the plant producing clinker, a cement raw material, but he estimated damage at "tens of millions" of guilders.
He also said production would not be affected as ENCI had clinker stocks lasting more than one month.
"It means customers will receive cement as usual," Pluijmen told Reuters.
He said the company would have to buy clinker externally if the plant was not rebuilt before stocks ran out.
The explosion occured as part of the clinker production facility was being started up.
